title: Aabhas Gulati
text:
About
I work on quantum information theory. My thesis lies at the intersection of

Entanglement
Symmetry in quantum states
Polynomial optimization

More broadly, I am interested in:

Entanglement theory: bound entanglement, Schmidt numbers, resource theory of entanglement
Problems involving tensors and graphs

title: Aabhas Gulati
text:
Recent
Preprint: Optimal entanglement criteria from trace invariants, with Bivas Mallick and Ion Nechita.
Using convex duality, we explore the best entanglement criteria that can be built from finitely many trace invariants of a state, also introducing new ones using realignment moments.
Paper: Entanglement in the Dicke subspace, with Ion Nechita and Clement Pellegrini, in Quantum 10, 2150 (2026).
We connect the entanglement properties of mixtures of Dicke states to convex cones of completely positive and copositive tensors and their relaxations.
